label: preparing
what: An appreciation-of-municipal-public-service presentation in the town hall great hall at 18:00–18:30, organised by the innkeeper and local tradespeople. The appointment supplement explicitly says organisers need time to finish arrangements and the mayor must not enter early. Baker involvement is suggested by bread delivery and receipt of planks and a lantern from the builder, rather than directly confirmed. Secretary knowingly coordinates timing and access; builder appears to assist with supplies. The event itself has been disclosed, but its detailed arrangements have not.
